title: Pair Sum Indices
prompt:
You are given a slice of integers `nums` and an integer `target`. Exactly one pair of distinct positions i < j satisfies nums[i] + nums[j] == target. Return that pair as a tuple `(i, j)` with i < j.

Signature: `fn pair_sum_indices(nums: &[i32], target: i32) -> (usize, usize)`

You may not use the same position twice. Aim for a single pass over the slice (a HashMap helps).

Example:
  pair_sum_indices(&[4, 9, 1, 6], 7) -> (2, 3)   (1 + 6 = 7)
